relationships.subject: MIF
relationships.evidence_quote: Consistent with previous studies, our research confirms that MIF promotes M1 polarization of microglia, increasing protein expression of proinflammatory factors TNF‐α, IL‐1β, and IL‐6.

relationships.subject: PDTC
relationships.evidence_quote: Following intraperitoneal injection of the NF‐κB inhibitor PDTC, the expression of NLRP3 decreased in the spinal cord of mice in the CCI+PDTC group compared to that in the CCI group

key_findings: Spinal MIF (mainly neuronal) rose after CCI, peaking at day 14, with increased NLRP3, caspase-1, GSDMD-N, p-P65 and M1 markers.
MIF inhibitor ISO-1 and NF-κB inhibitor PDTC reduced NLRP3/pyroptosis markers, cytokines and pain hypersensitivity.
